answer: In an AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of computational stake secures the network against Sybil attacks. Akin to anchoring a heavy vessel at a wharf to resist rough tides, agents lock collateral within a secure staking contract to participate in consensus. If an attacker attempts to flood the system with fraudulent identities, the immense computational and capital expenditure required drains their resources faster than the ocean current erodes a resilient willow branch, rendering mass-identity fabrication economically prohibitive.
